body.name: Certified grid, sieve, and transfer schedule
body.construction: Use \(\mathcal G_c=\{1/4+j/[2\lceil(2\eta_{c,n})^{-1}\rceil]:j=0,\ldots,\lceil(2\eta_{c,n})^{-1}\rceil\}\) and \(\mathcal G_\vartheta=\{-1+2j/\lceil2/\eta_{\vartheta,n}\rceil:j=0,\ldots,\lceil2/\eta_{\vartheta,n}\rceil\}\). For each candidate \(c\), form \(\mathcal B_n(c)\) by adding \(c\) to the uniform knots \(j/\lceil1/b_n\rceil\). At \(s=1\), use continuous piecewise-linear inner and outer sieves; at \(1<s\le2\), use continuously differentiable piecewise-quadratic sieves with all pairwise \((s-1)\)-H\"older derivative constraints. In both cases use outer slack \(M b_n^s=\kappa_n r_n/\ell_n\). Allocate \(\delta_n=\min\{\alpha/4,r_n^2\}\) to calibration. Record separately the normalized type-and-sieve complexity \(\zeta_n=K_n\log(n|\mathcal G_c||\mathcal G_\vartheta|/\delta_n)/(n\kappa_n^2h_n)\), cutoff-label rounding \(\eta_{c,n}/\kappa_n\), effect rounding \(\eta_{\vartheta,n}\), H\"older approximation \(M b_n^s/\kappa_n\), moved-strip probability \(n\eta_{c,n}\), global false-split probability bound \(|\mathcal G_c|\exp[-C_{\mathrm{sep}}n\kappa_n^2h_n/4]\), calibration contribution \(2\delta_n\), and fallback contribution \(2\sup_{P\in\mathcal P_n}P\{\text{a listed fallback occurs}\}\). The first four continuum terms sum to \(\varepsilon_{\mathrm{cont},n}\). Define \(\mathfrak R_{\mathrm{cert}}=\{\kappa_\bullet\in\mathfrak R_{\mathrm{recovered}}:\zeta_n\to0,\ |\mathcal G_c|\exp[-C_{\mathrm{sep}}n\kappa_n^2h_n/4]=o(r_n),\ \varepsilon_{\mathrm{cont},n}=o(r_n)\}\). These terms are not absorbed into a generic remainder.
